description.zh: 共享给的账号列表。（只能是主账号，一次最多5个）
description.en: The list of Alibaba Cloud accounts with which to share the template. A maximum of five accounts can be specified at a time.
Specifies whether to add the template to or remove it from favorites.
The action to perform on the shared template.
The version of the shared template.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos update-template-attributes --template-name MyTemplate --is-favorite true --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --share-permission-action Share --share-template-version v1 --account-ids 1319994761488600 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun oos UpdateTemplateAttributes --region cn-hangzhou --ShareTemplateVersion v1 --AccountIds 1319994761488600 --SharePermissionAction Share --TemplateName MyTemplate --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --IsFavorite true
